inj.note: In his second game back from a multi-week high-ankle sprain, Douglas led the team with 31 routes on Malik Willis' 36 dropbacks against New England. The rookie wideout's six targets tied Greg Dulcich and Malik Washington for the team lead on a day Willis targeted nine different pass catchers. Through four games this season, Douglas has 13 grabs for 226 yards and two touchdowns on 19 targets. He's a low-volume big-play threat on the outside for Miami, but Douglas will be in the mix as a streamer for next Sunday's date with a leaky Lions secondary.

news.h: Miami Dolphins WR Caleb Douglas rounding into form ahead of Pats matchup
news.d: The rookie wide receiver has impressed Dolphins coaches with his production on and off the ball.

news.h: Dolphins rookie WR Caleb Douglas set to return vs. Jets
news.d: Miami Dolphins rookie receiver Caleb Douglas will play Sunday against the New York Jets after missing the past three games with a right ankle injury.
